bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; taxation; authorizing motor vehicle registration tax holiday for one year.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION TAX HOLIDAY.

Subdivision 1.

New purchases.

For all new and used vehicles purchased and registered in the state on or after January 1, 2027, and on or before December 31, 2027, the vehicle registration tax imposed under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, is waived.

Subd. 2.

Registration renewals.

(a) For all motor vehicle registration renewals due on or after January 1, 2027, and on or before December 31, 2027, the vehicle registration is automatically extended for 12 additional months and the tax imposed under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, is waived.

(b) New license plate tabs must not be issued for motor vehicle registrations automatically extended under this subdivision. The existing license plate tabs must be retained on the motor vehicle and remain valid for 12 months after the motor vehicle registration is automatically extended under this subdivision.

Subd. 3.

Electric vehicle surcharges.

(a) The provisions under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to electric vehicle surcharges payable under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, subdivision 1m.

(b) The provisions under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to plug-in hybrid electric vehicle surcharges payable under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, subdivision 1n.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: For all new and used vehicles purchased and registered in the state on or after January 1, 2027, and on or before December 31, 2027, the vehicle registration tax imposed under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, is waived.

(a) For all motor vehicle registration renewals due on or after January 1, 2027, and on or before December 31, 2027, the vehicle registration is automatically extended for 12 additional months and the tax imposed under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, is waived.

(b) New license plate tabs must not be issued for motor vehicle registrations automatically extended under this subdivision. The existing license plate tabs must be retained on the motor vehicle and remain valid for 12 months after the motor vehicle registration is automatically extended under this subdivision.
(a) The provisions under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to electric vehicle surcharges payable under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, subdivision 1m.
(b) The provisions under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to plug-in hybrid electric vehicle surcharges payable under Minnesota Statutes, section 168.013, subdivision 1n.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
